def insertion_index(values, target):
    lo, hi = 0, len(values)
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi)//2
        if values[mid] < target: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid
    return lo

steps.text: Repeat while lo is less than hi.
Check whether values[mid] is less than target. Set lo to mid + 1.
